ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactCardsOutstandingBalance_View]
	AS 

WITH FactCardsOutstandingBalance_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance as FDL
)

Select CCD.*
from DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance as CCD
    INNER JOIN FactCardsOutstandingBalance_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = CCD.BusinessDateSK
